svg.title: Melanotan case reports we read, by type of harm
svg.desc: Melanotan case reports we read, by type of harm. Melanoma or melanoma in situ: 5 reports. New or changing moles: 4 reports. Priapism (painful, lasting erection): 3 reports. Kidney or muscle injury: 2 reports. Brain swelling (PRES): 1 reports. Other skin or mouth changes: 2 reports.
